makemeahanzi.definition: boundary, limit; domain; society, the world

characterDeckComponents.note: 田 (field) — relates to 界's original meaning, the boundary line between farm fields.
介 (jiè) gives the sound — 界 is also pronounced jiè, an exact match.

makemeahanzi.definition: to seek, to search, to investigate

characterDeckComponents.note: 扌 (hand) shows 搜 relates to physically searching for something.
叟 (sǒu) gives a sound close to sōu, differing mainly in tone.

makemeahanzi.definition: even, uniform, of equal length
school; military field officer

characterDeckComponents.note: 木 (wood) — 校 originally related to a wooden framework, later coming to mean 'school,' a place of structured learning
交 (jiāo) gives a sound close to 校's reading xiào

meanings: used in 龜茲|龟兹[Qiu1 ci2]

makemeahanzi.definition: now, here; this; time, year
old, classic, ancient

etymology.hint: Words passing through ten 十 mouths 口

characterDeckComponents.note: 十 (ten) — suggests something repeated many times.
口 (mouth) — a story passed down through ten generations of mouths gave 古 its meaning 'old, ancient.'

makemeahanzi.definition: to sow seeds, to scatter; to broadcast, to spread

etymology.hint: To sow seeds 番 by hand 扌; 番 also provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: 扌 (hand) — the hand doing the sowing.
番 (a field marked out into plots) — seeds scattered by hand across it, giving 播 its meaning 'to sow, to spread, to broadcast.'

makemeahanzi.definition: circle; circular, round; complete

characterDeckComponents.note: 囗 (enclosure) — 圆 describes a shape fully enclosed by a curved line: a circle.
员 (yuán) gives the sound — an exact match with 圆's reading yuán.

makemeahanzi.definition: diamond; to bore, to drill, to pierce

characterDeckComponents.note: Metal — 钻 relates to a metal tool, a drill.
Gives the sound zhàn, related to zuān but drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: court; courtyard; spacious hall or yard

etymology.hint: A wide 广 couryard 廷; 廷 also provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: 广 depicts a roofed building or shelter.
廷 depicts an open court or hall — together with the shelter above, giving 庭 its meaning 'courtyard, hall.'

makemeahanzi.definition: to submit to, to obey, to go along with

characterDeckComponents.note: 页 (head) is the semantic root here, though the exact link to 顺's meaning 'to follow' isn't fully clear today.
川 (chuān) reflects the character's historical phonetic root, though the modern reading shùn has diverged.

makemeahanzi.definition: to scatter, to disperse, to break up

etymology.hint: A hand 攵 tossing seeds from a basket

characterDeckComponents.note: 散 traditionally depicts a hand (攵) scattering something, like seeds tossed from a basket — the image behind its meaning 'to scatter, disperse.'

makemeahanzi.definition: bosom, breast; to carry in one's bosom

characterDeckComponents.note: 忄 (heart) — 怀 relates to feelings held close to the heart
不 (bù) gives a sound distantly related to 怀's reading huái, having drifted apart over time

makemeahanzi.definition: to love; to enjoy, to be happy; joyful, glad

etymology.hint: Singing 口 and beating drums 壴

characterDeckComponents.note: 壴 (a drum) — beating a drum in celebration
口 (mouth) — singing along in celebration

meanings: to stop doing sth for a period of time

makemeahanzi.definition: to rest; to stop; to retire

etymology.hint: A person 亻 leaning against a tree 木

characterDeckComponents.note: 亻 (person) leans to the side.
木 (tree) — a person resting against a tree gave 休 its meaning 'to rest.'

makemeahanzi.definition: to entice, to tempt; to arouse, to stir

characterDeckComponents.note: 辶 (walk) — an older semantic link to enticing someone to follow along.
豆 (dòu) gives the sound — an exact match with 逗.

makemeahanzi.definition: to appear, to manifest; current, now

etymology.hint: To see 见 jade 王; 见 also provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: 王 (a variant of 玉, meaning jade) — a valuable object one might glimpse or notice.
见 (to see) — catching sight of something links to the meanings 'to appear, present, now.'

makemeahanzi.definition: suffering; misfortune; trouble; to suffer

characterDeckComponents.note: 心 (heart/mind) — 患 describes a burden weighing on the mind, worry or suffering.
串 (chuàn) gives a rhyme close to huàn, with a different initial.

makemeahanzi.definition: good, virtuous, charitable, kind

etymology.hint: To give someone food 羊 and conversation 口

characterDeckComponents.note: 羊 (sheep) — food offered generously to another person
口 (mouth) — kind words spoken alongside the gift

makemeahanzi.definition: to wrap, to entangle; to involve; to bother, to annoy

characterDeckComponents.note: 纟 (thread) — winding and wrapping are described using the thread radical.
㢆 (a rare character) gives the sound — an exact match for 缠.

makemeahanzi.definition: sheep, goat

characterDeckComponents.note: 羊 is a simple picture of a sheep's head, seen from the front, with two curved horns at the top.

makemeahanzi.definition: barbarians; barbarous, rude, savage

characterDeckComponents.note: 亦 (also, similarly) contributes to the character's form.
虫 (insect) sits below it — an old, dismissive way of grouping outsiders with lowly creatures, behind 蛮's meaning 'barbarian.'

makemeahanzi.definition: skillful, ingenious, clever

characterDeckComponents.note: 工 (work, tool) — 巧 relates to skill in craft or work.
丂 (kǎo) gives a sound close to qiǎo.

makemeahanzi.definition: to rock, to shake; to swing, to wave

characterDeckComponents.note: 扌 (hand) — 摇 describes shaking or waving something by hand.
䍃 (yáo) gives the sound — an exact match with 摇.

makemeahanzi.definition: to boil, to simmer; to endure pain

characterDeckComponents.note: 灬 (fire) — 熬 describes cooking something slowly over a low flame.
敖 (áo) gives the sound — an exact match with 熬.

makemeahanzi.definition: to meet, to encounter, to come across

characterDeckComponents.note: 辶 (to walk) — encountering someone often happens while moving or traveling.
禺 (yú) gives a sound close to yù, with the tone shifted.

makemeahanzi.definition: share, portion; thighs, haunches, rump

characterDeckComponents.note: ⺼ (flesh/body) — 股 originally referred to the thigh, a part of the body
殳 (shū) gives a sound related to 股's reading gǔ, though the two have drifted apart over time

makemeahanzi.definition: form, shape; to appear; to describe; to look

etymology.hint: Sunlight 彡 streaming through a window 开

characterDeckComponents.note: 开 (open, here representing a frame or opening) — 形 pictures light passing through a gap.
彡 (streaks or rays of light) — light and pattern coming through an opening gave 形 its meaning 'shape' or 'form.'

makemeahanzi.definition: thin, lean, emaciated; meager

characterDeckComponents.note: Sickness — being extremely thin was once associated with illness.
Gives the sound sǒu, related to shòu but drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: flower bud

characterDeckComponents.note: 艹 (grass/plant) — the grass/plant radical, marking the character as related to plants or vegetation.
雷 (léi) gives a sound close to 蕾's reading lěi — the same syllable, differing only in tone.

makemeahanzi.definition: to slaughter, to butcher; to govern, to rule

etymology.hint: A barracks 宀 where slaves 辛 live

characterDeckComponents.note: 宀 (roof, house) — 宰 originally pictured an official's residence.
辛 (bitter, hard labor) contributes to the character's form, referring to the servants who worked there — giving 宰 its meanings 'to govern' and 'to slaughter.'

makemeahanzi.definition: thief, traitor; cunning, sly

characterDeckComponents.note: 戎 (weapons) — 贼 originally linked robbery and violence to arms.
贝 (money, from ancient shell currency) gives a sound distantly related to zéi, having drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: shelve, frame; files, records; grade, level

characterDeckComponents.note: Wood — shelves and frames were made of wood.
Gives the sound dāng, related to dàng but drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: hundred million; many

characterDeckComponents.note: 亻 (person) — historically, large numbers were tied to counting groups of people.
乙 (yǐ) gives a sound distantly related to yì, having drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: surely, certainly; must; will
palace; surname

characterDeckComponents.note: 宀 (roof) — 宫 names a palace, a grand building.
吕 (lǚ) reflects the character's historical phonetic root, though the modern reading gōng has diverged considerably.

makemeahanzi.definition: measure, volume; amount, quantity

characterDeckComponents.note: 里 (a unit of distance, related to a village measure) — 量 relates to measuring quantity.
旦 (dàn) gives a hint of the sound — 量 is pronounced liàng, a connection that has shifted significantly over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: carrot, radish, turnip

characterDeckComponents.note: 艹 (plant) — 萝 names a creeping vine or root vegetable.
罗 (luó) gives the sound — an exact match with 萝.

makemeahanzi.definition: small thing, child; young animal

etymology.hint: A person 亻 keeping watch over a child 子; 子 also provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: 亻 (person) on the left represents someone tending to something small.
子 (child) on the right depicts the small, young thing being watched over, giving 仔 its meaning of something small or young.

makemeahanzi.definition: to sew, to mend

characterDeckComponents.note: Thread — sewing uses thread.
Gives the sound féng, matching the character's other reading (as a verb meaning 'to sew').

makemeahanzi.definition: to lick, to taste

characterDeckComponents.note: 舌 (tongue) — depicts a tongue, marking the character as related to the mouth or speech.
忝 (tiǎn) gives the sound — an exact match with 舔's reading.

makemeahanzi.definition: curtain, screen, tent; measure word for plays and shows

characterDeckComponents.note: 巾 (cloth) — 幕 names a large piece of cloth, a curtain or screen.
莫 (mò) gives a sound close to mù, sharing the same rhyme.

makemeahanzi.definition: to frighten, to startle; surprise, alarm

characterDeckComponents.note: 忄 (heart) — 惊 relates to an emotional reaction of shock or fright
京 (jīng) gives the sound — an exact match with 惊's reading jīng

makemeahanzi.definition: to recommend, to advise; to urge, to exhort

etymology.hint: The power 力 beside 又 the throne

characterDeckComponents.note: 力 (strength, effort) represents exertion directed at someone.
又 (a hand) suggests reaching out to someone, giving 劝 its meaning 'to urge, to advise.'

makemeahanzi.definition: younger sister

characterDeckComponents.note: 女 (woman) — 妹 names a female relative, a younger sister.
未 (wèi) gives a rhyme close to mèi, with a different initial.

meanings: used in 夾肢窩|夹肢窝[ga1 zhi5 wo1]

makemeahanzi.definition: to support; to be wedged between

etymology.hint: A person 夫 stuck between two others 丷

characterDeckComponents.note: A person shape in the middle.
Two smaller marks pressing in from either side, like being sandwiched.

makemeahanzi.definition: to absorb, to annex; to engulf; to swallow

characterDeckComponents.note: Mouth — swallowing happens through the mouth.
Gives the sound tiān, related to tūn but drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: ashes; dust; lime, mortar

etymology.hint: The remains of a fire 火; 火 also provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: 灰 depicts the leftover ash of a fire 火 below, mixed with dust — the source of its meaning 'ash, gray.'

makemeahanzi.definition: to deceive, to lie; to regard with suspicion

characterDeckComponents.note: 目 (eye) — 瞒 relates to concealing something from someone's view.
㒼 (mán) gives the sound — an exact match with 瞒.

makemeahanzi.definition: to trample, to tread on, to walk over

characterDeckComponents.note: Foot — the action of stepping is done with the feet.
Gives the sound tà, matching the character's reading.
